cases.title: Dora MES — Textile Manufacturing Operating System
cases.summary: End-to-end digitalization of the factory flow, replacing spreadsheets with a high-ergonomics PWA.
cases.challenge: Synchronizing sewing batches with heterogeneous cycle times. Treating the Production Order as a single block caused queues and unreal data. Shop floor operation by workers wearing gloves in textile dust.

cases.title: Use Azevedo — E-Commerce Mobile-First & Fit Tech

cases.challenge: Overcoming mobile purchase insecurity (reducing high return rates due to fit errors in the mid/plus size niche) and eliminating the founder's technical dependency to manage catalog, stocks, and media.

experiments.title: EchoOrganize (Low-Level Audio Firmware Patch)
